description: PRESS RELEASE The Executive Board and the Representative Council of the Oakland Education Association (OEA) gave their unanimous endorsements for Mark Rendón for State Assembly, AD-14. Watch Rendón’s endorsement interview with the OEA here .

title: Mark Rendón Receives Unanimous Endorsement from the Oakland Education Association — Mark Rendón for AD14
